title: Steps Graph should be simplified
body:
I can't understand steps graph, with lots of overlapping on some periods

![Screenshot_20231231-151038_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/52934600/fdf7a16c-246a-4aa8-a45c-6855be3d82b0)

In above graph, I have bars close to 40 and at the same time a green bar close to 180 ?

To be able to understand graph, I think we should show for example something like "number of steps during the last minute" to avoid overlapping...
